name: The Village Pub
description: A long-running neighborhood tavern on North Broadway with craft beer on tap and food from a food truck out back. It books local cover and tribute bands, mostly on weekends.

dancing.notes: The pub's own Facebook page thanked a party-rock band for getting the crowd dancing, so people do get up and move on band nights. We found no details on how much open floor there is; it is a regular bar room, so space is probably limited.

evidence.note: The pub's own post praises an 80s party band for getting the crowd dancing and joining in.
Music listing describes a laid-back local pub with cover bands, acoustic acts and weekend entertainment.
Review summary calls it an old-school local pub with live music, free pool on Tuesdays and food made in a truck in back.
